purpose: Secondary rectifier loading and conditional thermal envelope; not a regulator stability or safety model.
winding_basis: Illustrative 18V at 0.25A with 10/20% resistive voltage-rise approximation. Not measurements or a transformer model; primary loss, leakage and saturation omitted.

load_basis.audio: Six OPA2134 channels at 5mA maximum quiescent per amplifier at stated datasheet conditions gives30mA each rail; 20/70mA added reserve is a test assumption, not a validated maximum signal/fault budget.
load_basis.logic: 2/10/20mA scenario assumptions; not a verified current budget. Idle can violate L7805 minimum5mA regulation condition.
load_basis.relay: G5V-2-H1 DC12 960ohm +/-10% at23C; use12.6V/864ohm per energized coil, ignoring transistor voltage drop. Colder operation remains to qualify.

iq_basis: L78 8mA plus1mA line/0.5mA load variation; L79 3mA plus1mA line/0.5mA load variation. Planning screens using tabulated conditions; not universal guaranteed startup/fault limits.
raw_screen_basis: Intersection of L7812C/L7815C documented regulation test ranges at modest load, and L7915C range. Outside means unqualified, not an exact predicted dropout transition.
thermal_basis: 100C junction is engineering target;1C/W insulator/contact path and ambient are assumptions. Shared sink computation includes all four regulators; no selected heatsink or measured chassis temperature.

sources.scope: Tables2,10,15,16, minimum load and regulation ranges

limitations: No regulator control-loop/macromodel; loads are imposed on raw rails after a startup ramp.
No DC-output startup, reverse-current, protection, audio clipping or relay transient qualification.
Generic exponential diode model is an assumed rectification surrogate, not exact selected1N4007 model.
No transformer selection, mains-switch/fuse approval or Shanghai procurement qualification.
No inferred socket qualification from current or thermal results.
thermal_electrical_corner_basis: Use minimum output bounds for device dissipation and maximum12.6V U5 input. Sum of independent worst-direction bounds is conservative; not one simultaneous output-voltage corner. Valid only while regulation holds and within stated current/temperature assumptions.
